candidateDefinition: Recommendation-visible standalone or point-of-interest destination records surfaced by the frozen KAI-151 thematic candidate/exposure audit; hubs and already-sufficient records are retained for classification but are not mutated.
selectionMethod: Frozen five-duration recommendation exposure (shortOuting, halfDay, fullDay, 2d1n, 3d2n) across Tokyo, Osaka, and Fukuoka origins, filtered to the thematic signal and reviewed against destination-specific official operator, municipal, prefectural, or official tourism evidence.

records.name: Mitarai Valley

seasonMetadata.basis: Official sources provide identity, hours, reservation, or route context but not a defensible four-season suitability vector; unknown is preserved.

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone nature destination with a direct autumn-foliage signal.

observations: The venue page says the vivid leaves are spectacular against the emerald waters in autumn and that leaves peak around early to mid-November.

records.decisionNote: Exact official peak window is mapped conservatively to November; no narrower date is asserted.

records.name: Wakayama Castle

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone castle with a named autumn garden signal.

observations: The official seasonal-flower page lists the Momijidani Garden autumn scene and says its usual viewing period is late November to early December.

records.decisionNote: The official page supports late November to early December; only November is retained as the conservative structured peak because December is classified as winter by the season model.

records.name: Oirase Mountain Stream & Gorge

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone gorge with a strong foliage description but no defensible month window in the checked first-party page.

officialEvidence.authority: Towada Oirase Tourism Organization / Towada Travel
observations: The official destination guide describes Lake Towada and Oirase Gorge turning red in autumn and calls the scenery photogenic, but the checked page does not publish a recurring month window.

records.decisionNote: Leave unknown; autumn-only wording is insufficient for exact bestMonths.

records.name: Meiji no Mori Mino Quasi-National Park

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: High-exposure standalone park with autumn foliage association but no recurring peak window in the authoritative page checked.

officialEvidence.authority: Osaka Prefectural Government / Minoh City Tourism Association
observations: The official material identifies Meiji no Mori Minoh as a natural park and says Minoh is especially visited during the autumn foliage season; individual 2026 walks are dated but do not establish a recurring park-wide peak window.

records.decisionNote: Do not convert a dated event into a general best-month vector.

records.name: Kinrin Lake

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

records.cohortReason: Standalone nature POI with an autumn/winter mist signal but no foliage peak window.

observations: The official page says Kinrin Lake can be seen enveloped in fantastical morning mist from autumn through winter; it does not establish a foliage-specific month window.

records.decisionNote: Seasonal mist is not enough to assert an autumn foliage vector.

records.name: Makino Metasequoia Avenue

seasonMetadata.basis: Official sources provide local hours, route, or event context but not a defensible four-season suitability score; unknown is preserved. Famous seasonal scenery (e.g. autumn foliage) is not by itself a defensible monthly vector.

records.cohortReason: Standalone linear scenic attraction with seasonal imagery but no defensible peak window.

observations: The official guide identifies the 2.4 km metasequoia avenue and its seasonal scenery; the checked page does not provide a recurring foliage month window.

records.decisionNote: Roadside seasonal scenery remains unknown under the season-model policy.

records.name: Bitchu Matsuyama Castle

seasonMetadata.basis: no rule matched; owner policy: unknown stays unknown

observations: The official site documents the mountain castle and visitor information; the checked pages did not provide a defensible recurring foliage window.

records.decisionNote: Do not infer months from general autumn imagery.
